summary: Equinox Gold filed a 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a press release reporting Q3 2026 production after completing its business combination with Orla Mining on July 31, 2026. The filing cites two months of attributable output from Musselwhite and Camino Rojo, Q3 production of 237,019 oz, and YTD production of 611,483 oz. Equinox reiterated 2026 guidance of 870,000-920,000 oz and described a strengthened balance sheet, including $1.2 billion of debt repayments, $163 million net cash, and $1.2 billion liquidity. Watch integration, guidance, and share repurchases.
